packageRules.description: Exclude SNAPSHOT versions, renovate may suggest them for pre-release values.

kafka-clients: stay on the Apache versioning track. The Confluent Platform builds (-ce/-ccs/-cp suffixes, e.g. 8.2.1-ce) are republished under the same org.apache.kafka coordinates via artifacts.camunda.com and must not be treated as upgrades to the Apache releases (x.y.z).

Disable minor/major updates for google-auth-library-oauth2-http — 1.50.0+ removes the setSecurityProvider method used by connector-google-gemini's vertexai client, breaking its tests. Requires code migration.

Disable minor/major updates for the Google Cloud libraries-bom used by connector-google-gemini specifically — 26.86.0+ pulls in google-auth-library-oauth2-http 1.50.0+ which breaks the connector's vertexai tests. Scoped to the files that feed that module; the independently-versioned libraries-bom in secret-providers/pom.xml is unaffected and can keep updating.

Disable updates for bcpkix-jdk18on/bcprov-jdk18on — 1.85.2 is an incomplete BouncyCastle release (bcprov-jdk18on was published at 1.85.2 but bcpkix-jdk18on/bcutil-jdk18on were not, so the shared version.bouncycastle property can't resolve on Maven Central). An allowedVersions exclusion for just 1.85.2 was tried first but didn't stop Renovate from re-proposing it — Renovate's Maven property-grouping picks the newest version reported by any one dependency sharing the property (bcprov-jdk18on) and applies it to all of them, bypassing the per-package version filter. Full disable until a consistent release exists across all bc*-jdk18on artifacts, then re-enable.
